Evidence: km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d; km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063."],"facts":[{"claim":"System view: this is a transport-capacity setup, not evidence of lost U.S. production or end-user demand. Today and through the next seven days, the largest unchanged-schedule gap is only 3,684 Dth/day and remains below the review threshold. The forward peak is September 14–20 at Station 860 in TGP Zone 1: an 868,000 Dth/day gross capacity reduction and a 668,684 Dth/day conditional shortfall if the August 30 schedule is unchanged. This is the largest single constraint screen, not an aggregate supply loss, because overlapping station and segment constraints cannot be summed. The missing denominator is point-in-time regional supply, demand, measured flow, and rerouting. Evidence: km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063; km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"]},{"claim":"The market picture is an unconfirmed regional-basis watch, not a trade-ready setup. Transport setup is present; demand overlap, regional-price confirmation, and flow-or-rerouting confirmation are not observed; inventory backdrop is available. Directional price sign and exact contract mapping remain unresolved. It is a report revision, not proof that physical flow changed. Evidence: km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932512717694000:4e5308a6b60198988cebfe87c90c7936ec29248dea254a2e2949d8b71262ebc6; km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932512717694000:4e5308a6b60198988cebfe87c90c7936ec29248dea254a2e2949d8b71262ebc6","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"The ledger also records improved forecast capacity at Station 245, segment 245 FH, from 680,000 to 970,000 Dth/day (+290,000 Dth/day), and at Station 409A, segment 492 FH, from 125,000 to 274,000 Dth/day (+149,000 Dth/day). These revisions partly counter a one-way tightening interpretation and are not proof of physical-flow changes. Regional basis is the plausible channel, but transport is the only present gate: demand overlap, regional-price confirmation, and flow-or-rerouting confirmation are not observed, while inventory context is available.
